name: Muramite Citadel: Heart of Discord
summary: The arcane core of the Citadel where Discord energy is concentrated, shaped, and unleashed.
description: The Heart of Discord is the most dangerous chamber in the entire Muramite Citadel Complex. Discord energy pulses through the air, warping stone, flesh, and magic. Ritual anchors channel raw Discord power into weapons, wards, and arcane constructs. Muramite Inquisitors oversee rituals that bend reality, while Discord manifestations roam freely. The terrain is unstable, the air crackles with energy, and every step risks triggering catastrophic arcane surges. Only the highest-ranking Muramite officers may enter this chamber.
